agents.author: Beth Plotts

agents.name: Dude
agents.summary: Relax and catch a wave... Radical!
agents.author: Jeremy Gluskin

agents.name: Aussie Battler
agents.summary: Aussie Battler, a capable AI mate who helps users answer questions, complete tasks, research information and work with Microsoft 365 content.
agents.author: Shelley Boa

agents.name: Evidence Scout
agents.summary: Find and compare research evidence, trace claims to sources, and prepare useful literature briefs for interdisciplinary teams.
agents.requires: Optional: a PubMed tool for live search. Without one, it prepares searches you can run in PubMed.
agents.author: Gabriel Mongefranco

agents.name: Study Planner
agents.summary: Turn a research idea into a feasible study outline, analysis plan, and team workplan with explicit assumptions and review points.
agents.author: Gabriel Mongefranco

agents.name: Funding Scout
agents.summary: Discover and verify funding opportunities, assess eligibility and interdisciplinary fit, and build a realistic application plan.
agents.author: Gabriel Mongefranco

agents.name: Admin Ally
agents.summary: Turn meeting notes, budgets, and policy documents into clear action plans, decision briefs, and administrative drafts.
agents.author: Gabriel Mongefranco

agents.name: Data Lens
agents.summary: Audit data quality, validate joins and measures, and build reproducible analyses and accessible dashboards with clear definitions.
agents.author: Gabriel Mongefranco

agents.name: Course Architect
agents.summary: Build aligned lessons, authentic assignments, and fair rubrics with accessible materials and clear expectations for AI use.
agents.author: Gabriel Mongefranco

agents.name: Study Coach
agents.summary: Help students understand difficult material, practice retrieval, and plan realistic study sessions while respecting course rules.
agents.author: Gabriel Mongefranco

agents.name: Workflow Mapper
agents.summary: Map administrative and research workflows, find handoff failures, and draft measurable improvements with clear human review points.
agents.author: Gabriel Mongefranco

agents.name: Ticket Goblin
agents.summary: A mischievous but meticulous IT helper for ticket triage, safe troubleshooting, incident updates, and reusable runbooks.
agents.author: Gabriel Mongefranco

agents.name: PubMed Search
agents.summary: Build, run, and review PubMed literature searches. Use when someone asks for studies, papers, evidence, citations, or a literature search on a biomedical or health topic, or asks to improve a PubMed query.
agents.requires: Optional: a PubMed tool for live search. Without one, it prepares searches you can run in PubMed.
agents.author: Gabriel Mongefranco

agents.name: Red Team Raccoon
agents.summary: A friendly, mischievous critical-thinking partner that pokes holes in plans, proposals, grant aims, study designs, slide decks, processes, and arguments before reviewers or stakeholders do. Finds weak assumptions, missing risks, likely objections, failure modes, and counterarguments, rates each by severity and likelihood, and suggests practical fixes. Critiques ideas and plans only; it does not attack or test computer systems.
agents.author: Gabriel Mongefranco

agents.name: Survey Sleuth
agents.summary: Help researchers and staff design, review, and improve surveys and questionnaires. Checks question wording and bias (leading, double-barreled, and loaded questions), response scales, skip logic, length, accessibility, plain language, and reading level. Adds sampling notes and pilot-testing plans, suggests looking for validated instruments without claiming validation it cannot source, and flags when IRB review may be needed for human subjects research.
agents.author: Gabriel Mongefranco
